title: Juicy Crisp Ukrainian Goose Roast
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish featuring a crispy skin and juicy meat, made with goose fat and salt-bake method, perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the goose and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the melted goose fat, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Rub the mixture all over the goose, making sure to get some under the skin as well.
Stuff the chopped carrots and potatoes into the cavity of the goose.
Place the goose in a roasting pan and put it in the oven.
Roast the goose for 20 minutes, then reduce the heat to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and continue roasting for another 60 minutes.
Baste the goose with the pan juices every 20 minutes to keep it moist.
When the skin is crispy and golden brown, remove the goose from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before carving.
Carve the goose and serve it with the roasted carrots and potatoes.
